sections.heading: 1. Protect wrists and shoulders
lines: ① Wrap snugly, but no tingling fingers.
② Punch slowly first to learn the straight line.
③ Drive from back foot → hips → shoulder.
④ Band rotator cuff and grip work twice a week.

go numb — get it checked before next class.

caption:
Lulu's hooked on after-work boxing, but his wrists ache the next day and the front of his shoulder grumbles.

Most of it comes back to basics. Wrap your hands snugly and wear gloves that fit. On impact, land with knuckles, wrist and forearm in one line, and slow your punches down while you learn the shape. Drive from your back foot and hips so the shoulder finishes the punch. Back after a break? Start with fewer rounds and add band work for rotator cuff and grip twice a week.

Swelling, pain over a knuckle, an unstable shoulder or numb fingers are worth an assessment. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help. Book online via the link in bio 🥊
